disposition_reason: Ninety-six retail milk and almond and oat beverage samples from UK supermarkets were analysed by ICP-MS/ICP-OES; Tables 1-3 and 5 print means by ingredient, production system and season, including cadmium, chromium and nickel.

study.design: UK retail survey of conventional and organic milk and almond and oat plant-based beverages over two seasons
study.market: major UK supermarkets (online retail survey March-May 2023)
study.method: microwave HNO3/HCl digestion; ICP-OES (macrominerals), ICP-MS Agilent 7900 (trace elements and heavy metals)
study.lod_text: Pb, Al, Sn below LOQ (0.44, 1.08, 0.25 µg/kg); other LOD/LOQ in Tables S1-S2 (not in PDF)
study.qa: ERM-BD150 skim milk powder CRM, recoveries 91-98% (Cu 87%); procedural blanks; 30% duplicates within ±5%
